name: samarth
description: Samarth Rayar's Claude Code plugins: mods, skills, subagents, hooks and MCP servers

plugins.name: hud
plugins.description: A live usage cockpit above the prompt: context, plan limits with pace forecasts, and cost by day, week and month, in a one-line glance that expands into tabs and a dashboard pane

plugins.name: constellation
plugins.description: A night sky behind the desktop app that maps your work: every file Claude touches becomes a star, and files edited together join into constellations that build up per project

plugins.name: real-sky
plugins.description: A quiet sky almanac behind the desktop app: the sun and moon ride an hour arc at your local time, the colors follow the light, and the weather and a barometer follow the session

plugins.name: pixel-room
plugins.description: A lo-fi pixel desk scene behind the desktop app with rain on the window and a cat that sleeps until Claude works, a lamp that comes on at night and soft sounds on finish or failure
